verdict.rationale: Interview intelligence is a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but the evidence pack never mentions interview recording, transcription, AI-generated notes or summaries, scorecard auto-fill, or candidate consent handling. The Workable Agent covers sourcing and screening before interviews, and the rate-candidate API is a developer building block, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled
